name: Gibraltar
summary_text: Gibraltar: own legal system; same-sex marriage and protections in force; none of the EHRC single-sex code machinery applies; small, safe, tourism-oriented. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of +0.10. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Judge rules Scottish guidance for housing trans prisoners is unlawful - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about Scotland's prison policy for trans prisoners (June 2026 ruling), not Gibraltar; included as UK-context material (Gibraltar is a British Overseas Territory).

sources.title: Suicide risk if trans prisoners are put in jails based on sex at birth, court told - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about the same Scottish prison-housing litigation (Feb 2026), not Gibraltar; included as UK-context material only.

UK House of Commons Foreign Affairs Committee, Seventh Report (2007-08) on Overseas Territories: governance chapter - covers good-governance expectations, corruption concerns (Turks and Caicos), and accountability issues across the territories including Gibraltar.

sources.title: Gay rights in Gibraltar: Gibraltar puts same-sex marriage bill before Parliament | Spain | EL PAÍS English
sources.claim_summary: El País in English (Aug 2016): Gibraltar put a same-sex marriage bill before Parliament after a December 2015 popular consultation showed overwhelming support (3,490 responses of a 24,117 electorate); Chief Minister Picardo said Gibraltarians were 'polarized' on the issue.

sources.title: Ministry for Justice considers legislation to tackle ‘disgusting lurking homophobia’
sources.claim_summary: Gibraltar Chronicle (July 2021): the Ministry for Justice will 'urgently' consider making it a specific crime to denigrate a person because of sexual orientation, after 'disgusting lurking homophobia' on social media during Pride month; Picardo: 'Homophobia... will not be tolerated here.'

Wikiwand (Wikipedia mirror): LGBTQ rights in Gibraltar - legal since 1993, equal age of consent since 2012, adoption right by Supreme Court ruling 2013, civil partnerships since 2014, same-sex marriage since Dec 2016 (passed unanimously), discrimination protections for sexual orientation and 'gender reassignment' since 2007; transgender persons not allowed to change legal gender.
